crossRefs.note: He called the gatekeepers; and they told it to the king’s household within.

translations.web: He called the gatekeepers; and they told it to the king’s household within.
translations.bsb: The gatekeepers shouted the news, and it was reported to the king’s household.
translations.kjv: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king's house within.
translations.asv: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king's household within.
